title: CCNL Extraction Schema
description: Structured fields to extract from Italian Collective Bargaining Agreement (CCNL) text bodies. Every field is nullable and none are required: the extractor must emit null rather than guess when a value is not explicitly stated in the source text.

sector.description: Industry/sector this CCNL covers, as stated in the document (e.g. 'metalmeccanico', 'commercio').

wage_increases.description: Wage increase events explicitly stated in the text. Empty array if none found.

effective_date.description: ISO-8601 date if determinable, else the original date string.

level_or_category.description: Job level/category the increase applies to (e.g. 'livello 3', 'quadri'), if differentiated.

amount_eur.description: Absolute increase amount in EUR, if stated.

probation_period_days.description: Probation period length in days, by worker category. Null for categories not covered.

notice_period_days.description: Notice period (preavviso) length in days, by worker category. Null for categories not covered.

leave_entitlements.description: Leave provisions explicitly stated in the text.

annual_leave_days.description: Annual paid leave (ferie) entitlement in days.

sick_leave_terms.description: Free-text summary of sick leave (malattia) terms, if stated.

parental_leave_terms.description: Free-text summary of parental leave terms, if stated.
